answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, reset on any identity-link attempt, rewards vest against future work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. What survives to the raven is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The mesa holds work receipts rather than names, so the island of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
